ms.report:
AdaStat New Website RC is released on https://new.adastat.net/
Please use 'catalyst' for both name and password to login
1. Updated UI

Search Page
・Improved and refined UI.
・Search field is located:
・In the navigation bar on mobile devices.
・In the header on desktop.
・The search opens in a modal window.
・Includes search history.
・Supports searching across all sections of the website, including sections not previously announced (DReps and Gov Actions).

Watchlist (Favorites) https://new.adastat.net/watchlist
・Improved and redesigned UI.
・Items added to Watchlist are also displayed on the Dashboard.

You can add the following to your Watchlist:
・Accounts https://new.adastat.net/accounts
・Pools https://new.adastat.net/pools
・Tokens https://new.adastat.net/tokens
・DReps https://new.adastat.net/dreps

To add an item:
・Click the ⭐ star icon in lists, or
・Click the ⭐ star icon on the item's dedicated page.

2. Support for Public Cardano Testnets
・Added support for Cardano public testnets.
・Network selector allows switching between:
・Mainnet
・Preprod
・Preview
・Network selectors are located on the right side of the footer.
